clue.text: Endless banter with line I'm spinning

indicators.note: spinning suggests the letters of banter, line and I'm are whirled into a new order

explanation.surface: A tedious chat-up line keeps going round and round in someone's head.
explanation.definitionFit: Something interminable never seems to finish, so it is a synonym of endless.

clue.text: As an alternative, detains criminal

indicators.note: criminal suggests the letters of detains are crooked, rearranged unlawfully

explanation.surface: A police report: rather than charging him, someone holds a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in place of another is doing it as an alternative; an adverb in both.

clue.text: Itch oddly then take pulse

indicators.note: oddly asks for alternate letters of itch, here the second and fourth

parts.note: to take something unlawfully is to rob

explanation.surface: A patient with an itch is then told to take their pulse.
explanation.definitionFit: A pulse is a rhythmic beat, the same as a throbbing beat of the heart.

clue.text: Show envy going after Queen record

indicators.note: going after means the piece from envy is placed after the queen and record pieces

parts.note: R, for Regina, is the usual abbreviation for a queen
an EP is an extended-play record
to envy someone can be to resent their good fortune

explanation.surface: Someone shows jealousy after the Queen sets a new record.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent something can be to depict or show it, as a painting does.

clue.text: Bird's in bliss on and off

indicators.note: on and off means taking every other letter of in bliss, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A bird enjoys happy moments only intermittently.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-billed wading bird, an example of the category.

clue.text: Debate advanced and divided catching stick

indicators.note: catching means the word for divided holds the word for stick inside it

parts.note: rent means torn apart or divided
gum is an adhesive used to stick things

explanation.surface: An advanced class splits into groups while someone grabs a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A debate is an exchange of opposing views, which is what an argument is.

clue.text: Enjoyed getting beaten without clubs

indicators.note: without tells us to drop the letter for clubs from the word for beaten

parts.note: licked means beaten or thrashed, informally
C is the card-playing abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A golfer enjoyed losing despite having no clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: To have liked something is to have enjoyed it; both past tense verbs.

clue.text: Mate who's drunk a bit

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of mate who's are staggering into a new order

parts.note: taken with all its letters, w, h, o and s

explanation.surface: A friend asks whose pint was drunk, a little.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat means to some degree, as does the adverbial phrase a bit.

clue.text: French artist capturing grand attractive person

indicators.note: capturing means the painter's name holds the letter for grand within it

parts.note: Edouard Manet was a French Impressionist painter
G is an abbreviation for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A French painter captures a grand, attractive sitter on canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who draws others to them is figuratively a magnet.

clue.text: Lad with catapult taking tumble

indicators.note: taking means the catapult word takes the tumble word inside it

parts.note: a sling is a simple catapult for hurling stones
a trip is a stumble or tumble

explanation.surface: A boy with a catapult takes a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripling is a youth or young lad, an old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: Capital of Sweden?

parts.note: capital here means money, not a chief city, so the Swedish currency is meant

explanation.definitionFit: The krona is Sweden's currency, and capital can mean money rather than a seat of government.

clue.text: Tremble madly, hugging figure

indicators.note: hugging means the answer is held within the words tremble madly

explanation.surface: Someone shakes wildly while embracing a statue.
explanation.definitionFit: An emblem is a symbolic figure or device, such as a heraldic design.

clue.text: Bit by dog, mine unfortunately, after seconds

indicators.note: after means the rearranged letters come after the abbreviation for seconds
unfortunately suggests the letters of dog and mine have been knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Someone complains their dog was bitten, sadly, moments later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bit' looks like the past tense of bite, but it is the definition, a noun meaning a small amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A smidgeon is a tiny amount, so a small bit.

clue.text: One sketches model's middle comparatively naked

indicators.note: middle asks for the central letter of the word model

parts.note: raw can mean naked or exposed, so rawer is more naked

explanation.surface: An artist sketches a model's midriff, which is rather more exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawer is a person who draws, so one who sketches.

clue.text: One acting so suspiciously?

indicators.note: suspiciously suggests the letters of acting so are not as they should be and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone asks who would behave in such a doubtful way.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a doubter about God is someone who treats belief suspiciously.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who doubts the existence of God regards belief with suspicion, behaving as the clue describes.

clue.text: Sun spread rejected sexy photo

indicators.note: rejected means the word for spread is turned back on itself

parts.note: a span is a spread or extent
hot means sexy, informally

explanation.surface: A tabloid like The Sun declines to spread a racy picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot is an informal photograph taken quickly.

clue.text: Right killjoy covers disgusting eye-opener

indicators.note: covers means the killjoy word surrounds the disgusting word

parts.note: a prig is a self-righteous person, a killjoy
vile means disgusting
the opening letter of eye

explanation.surface: A spoilsport hides a revolting revelation.
explanation.definitionFit: A privilege is a special right or entitlement.

clue.text: Superman at He-Man's tackling Bane

indicators.note: tackling means the answer is gripped inside the run of words superman at he-man's

explanation.surface: Two cartoon heroes clash, one tackling the villain Bane.
explanation.walkthrough: Bane is a comic-book villain in the surface, but here it means a curse.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is anathema is a thing one detests, a bane.

clue.text: Faithful concerned with good man consumed by hypocrisy

indicators.note: consumed by means the two pieces are swallowed inside the word for hypocrisy

parts.note: cant is hypocritical, pious talk
on means about or concerned with
ST, for saint, is a good man in crossword convention

explanation.surface: A loyal follower worries about a good man eaten up by hypocrisy.
explanation.definitionFit: Constant means steadfast and loyal, so faithful.

clue.text: Order fish provided by day's end

parts.note: cod is a fish
if means provided that

indicators.note: end asks for the final letter of day

explanation.surface: Someone orders fish, provided it comes by the end of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: To codify is to arrange rules into a systematic order.

clue.text: Beat America, putting first of astronauts in space

indicators.note: in means the chosen letter goes inside the word for beat

parts.note: to hit is to beat

indicators.note: first of asks for the opening letter of astronauts

parts.note: US is short for the United States

explanation.surface: A space race: one nation beats America by sending its astronauts up first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'space' suggests outer space in the surface, but it means a gap.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiatus is a gap or pause, so a space in time or sequence.

clue.text: Deceit of sweetheart caught in modest embrace

indicators.note: embrace means the modest word holds the middle letter inside it

parts.note: slight means modest or small
the heart of sweet, its middle letter

explanation.surface: A lover's trickery is caught out during a shy hug.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight is cunning or trickery, as in sleight of hand, so deceit.

clue.text: Single record on turntable ends

parts.note: a disc is a record
re means on or about

indicators.note: ends asks for the first and last letters of turntable

explanation.surface: A single record is placed on the turntable at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Single' looks like a record format, but it is the definition, meaning separate.
explanation.definitionFit: Discrete means separate and distinct, so single as opposed to joined.

clue.text: Initially rotating arms does involve individual bones

indicators.note: initially asks for the first letters of rotating, arms, does and involve

parts.note: I is one, an individual

explanation.surface: Rotating your arms involves individual bones from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: The radii are the forearm bones, plural of radius.

clue.text: Spot politician in imposing building

indicators.note: in means the politician is placed inside the building word

parts.note: a pile is a large imposing building such as a mansion
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: Someone spots a politician inside a grand mansion.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimple is a spot on the skin.

clue.text: Stance to keep one's balance

indicators.note: to keep means the stance word holds the letter for one

parts.note: a pose is a stance or posture
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone adopts a posture to stay balanced.
explanation.definitionFit: Poise is steadiness and equilibrium, so balance.

clue.text: Porridge mix

definitions.meaning: porridge is British slang for a prison sentence

explanation.definitionFit: Stir is slang for prison, as porridge is, and also means to mix by moving a spoon.

clue.text: Cooked as French — in other words, entrée for déjeuner

parts.note: i.e., id est, means in other words

indicators.note: entrée for means the entry or first letter of déjeuner

explanation.surface: A dish cooked the French way: the starter for lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: Déjeuner is French for lunch; 'entrée' suggests a starter dish but here means its opening letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Fried means cooked in hot fat, one way of being cooked.

clue.text: Rating coming down following case of excess

indicators.note: following means the rain word comes after the outer letters
case of means the outer letters of excess, its casing

parts.note: teeming means raining heavily, coming down

explanation.surface: A rating drops after an excessive case.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteeming means regarding or rating highly; both are present participles.

clue.text: Row of detectives with squad in a salute

parts.note: DIs are detective inspectors

indicators.note: in means the squad word sits inside the salute word

parts.note: to greet is to salute
men can make up a squad

explanation.surface: Detectives and a squad stand in a row to salute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' rhymes with cow here, a quarrel, not a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A row is a quarrel or argument, a disagreement.
